description: Suggest realistic next roles for the user based on one of their CVs, with the skills to build for each. PRO and AI consent. Use when the user asks what job to aim for next or how to change career.

cvId.description: The id of the CV to use (get it from list_my_takemeup_cvs).

locale.description: Language for results and links (en, de, fr, …). Defaults to the language of the user's TakeMeUp account.
